name: 49117 · New Buffalo, MI
findings: ZIP 49117 (New Buffalo) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49117 (New Buffalo) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
